solutions.title: Recursive region scan
solutions.strategy: For each square region, scan all cells to decide if it is uniform; otherwise recursively build four quadrants.

timeComplexity.explanation: At each recursion depth, region scans cover O(n^2) cells in total, and there are O(log n) levels for an n by n grid.

spaceComplexity.explanation: The recursion depth is logarithmic in the side length, excluding the required output tree.

solutions.title: Prefix-sum uniformity checks
solutions.strategy: Precompute a 2D prefix sum so each region can be classified as all zeroes, all ones, or mixed in constant time.

timeComplexity.explanation: The prefix table costs O(n^2), and the recursive build creates a number of nodes bounded by the grid cells.

spaceComplexity.explanation: The prefix-sum table stores one integer per grid coordinate, excluding the output tree.
